anomalies.description: A silver sedan on the right side of the road loses control, slides sideways across the lane, and appears to collide with or narrowly miss the camera vehicle, causing the view to abruptly tilt upward and become obscured by snow/spray.
A bus loses control on a snowy road, skids sideways across the lane, and collides with a red SUV ahead, causing a violent impact that ejects debris and sends parts of the bus airborne.
A white Lada car cuts in front of the dashcam vehicle and collides with it, causing the dashcam vehicle to veer right and crash into a blue truck, shattering the windshield.
